title: duplicate session ids across project dirs silently collide: 63 transcripts list as 61 sessions
description:
**Observed on real data (origin/develop `9fc6584`):** `botspy sources` counts **63** claude_code transcripts, but `botspy sessions -o json` lists **61**. `find ~/.claude/projects -name '*.jsonl'` shows two ids present in two project dirs each: `c58ebed2-7ae3-4257-89e9-ae4fd57e8408` and `cecba6ba-dc3e-4b13-b132-501b4600b3da`. `SessionStore::list_sessions` dedupes by session id alone ("first report wins"), so one transcript per duplicated id is silently dropped, losing its project and history from the listing. No warning is emitted.

**Repro:**
1. `./target/release/botspy sources` → claude_code SESSIONS 63.
2. `./target/release/botspy sessions -o json | length` → 61.
3. Diff the id sets → `c58ebed2…` and `cecba6ba…` each appear once despite two project dirs holding a transcript per id.

**Expected:** the store must key dedupe on more than the id — at minimum (agent, id, project_id) so the same id under two different projects lists twice (they are distinct histories); a true duplicate (same agent, id and project) still lists once. If identity stays id-only, the store must at least warn about collisions. No data may be silently dropped.

**Suspected code:** `src/session.rs` `SessionStore::list_sessions()` (~line 175-176): `seen.insert(summary.id.clone())`.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Regression test with **synthetic fixtures** (the `FixtureAdapter` or a temp-dir adapter layout — never real transcripts): two sessions sharing an id but differing in `project_id` both appear in `list_sessions()`; identical (agent, id, project) triples still dedupe to one row (the existing `duplicate_reports_of_one_session_list_once` behavior is preserved).
- A listing that drops a candidate must either not happen or say so (warning); the chosen behavior is documented in the method's doc comment.
- Note: `botspy sources`, `botspy doctor` and `botspy show` already work correctly on real data (`show` resolves by id; the collision only affects the unified listing).
- **Overlap with the local-store plan (BOTSPY-c7795b):** linked to task BOTSPY-a48fb1 ("Implement ingestion: adapters → store, read-only, dedup, lossless round-trip", epic BOTSPY-6f173d), which re-implements first-report-wins dedup inside the store. The fix here changes the chapter-1 rule in `src/session.rs` only — files that task does not touch (`src/store/*`) — and the store task should adopt the same keying when it lands; the local-store agent is notified on their task.

comments.text: Fixed on develop (commit 6fa7bf7). SessionStore::list_sessions now dedupes on the (agent, id, project_id) triple instead of id alone: the same id under two project dirs lists twice (both histories), true duplicate reports still list once (pre-existing duplicate_reports_of_one_session_list_once test untouched and green). Identity rule documented in the doc comment; Agent derives PartialOrd/Ord for the set key. Spec-first: scenario 'The same session id under two projects lists twice' with a new synthetic given step (duplicate solo-abc123.jsonl under dupe-demo — no real transcripts), watched red (4 sessions), green (5, both project names present); unit test same_id_under_two_projects_lists_twice covers the cross-adapter case. No warning surface was added since nothing is dropped anymore. All gates green (cargo test 44, bdd 167 passed, clippy/doc -D warnings, fmt). **Local-store link:** this was the dedup overlap with BOTSPY-a48fb1 — the store task should adopt the same triple keying for first-report-wins ingestion; notified on that task. sources, doctor and show were already correct on real data.
